Supplementary File 3
A printability-guided workflow for extrusion bioprinting of alginate–Aloe vera wound dressings
Abraham Isaí Zavaleta Romero, Fanny Casado, Rene Flores Clavo — Pontificia Universidad Católica del Perú
Fig. S1. Swelling of cast 2A-0.5AV hydrogels after 24 h of immersion in 1× PBS at 37 °C, as a function of drying route and CaCl₂ pre-crosslinking, with Kaltostat® as the commercial reference. Swelling (%) = (Wt − W0)/W0 × 100 (Eq. 9). Data are mean ± SD (n = 4 per group). Different letters indicate significant differences (Welch’s one-way ANOVA followed by Games–Howell post hoc test, adjusted p < 0.05). Blue, lyophilized; orange, oven-dried; grey, Kaltostat®; hatched bars, CaCl₂ pre-crosslinked. Raw data: Supplementary File 2, sheet Swelling_liquid_drymass_raw.
Table S1. Games–Howell pairwise comparisons for swelling (%). Welch’s one-way ANOVA: F(4, 6.80) = 243.5, p = 2.0 × 10⁻⁷. Mean difference = Group 2 − Group 1, in percentage points (pp).
Group 1 | Group 2 | Mean diff. (pp) | p-adj | 95% CI (pp) | Significant
Kaltostat® | Lyophilized | −759.22 | <0.001 | −917.91 to −600.53 | Yes
Kaltostat® | Lyophilized + CaCl₂ | −838.31 | <0.001 | −997.67 to −678.96 | Yes
Kaltostat® | Oven-dried | −1050.08 | <0.001 | −1225.96 to −874.20 | Yes
Kaltostat® | Oven-dried + CaCl₂ | −969.97 | <0.001 | −1140.60 to −799.34 | Yes
Lyophilized | Lyophilized + CaCl₂ | −79.09 | 0.113 | −177.20 to 19.01 | No
Lyophilized | Oven-dried | −290.85 | 0.002 | −390.25 to −191.46 | Yes
Lyophilized | Oven-dried + CaCl₂ | −210.75 | 0.003 | −304.75 to −116.74 | Yes
Lyophilized + CaCl₂ | Oven-dried | −211.76 | 0.003 | −298.13 to −125.39 | Yes
Lyophilized + CaCl₂ | Oven-dried + CaCl₂ | −131.66 | 0.009 | −213.22 to −50.09 | Yes
Oven-dried | Oven-dried + CaCl₂ | 80.11 | 0.003 | 41.73 to 118.48 | Yes
Statistics were computed from the unrounded per-sample values in Supplementary File 2.
